leaves.doc: Tian-Yuan-Zhang, Thm 3.3 (Gross-Zagier formula), printed form for n = 5, 7 (mod 8), with TYZ's adelic CM points: on some normal proper model (X, iota) of X0(32) (iota : K(X) = Q(j, j_32) in Q((q))), for every isomorphism of Q-schemes i0 : X -> A = Proj Q[X,Y,Z]/(Y^2 Z - X^3 - 4XZ^2) with i0(cusp oo) = O, w(n) = i0(f0(P_n)) for the C-points of X at f0(P_n), where P_n = [h, 1] in X_U(C) = GL2(Q)+ \ (H x GL2(A_f)/U) (U = {g in U0(32) : 4 | a - d}, A_f = Mathlib's FiniteAdeleRing Z Q) and h the fixed point in H of TYZ's image of sqrt(-n) in M2(Q) (arXiv:1411.4728v1 L1179-1240, L1296-1311, L1518-1520) (h33-g5)
leaves.flag: unread: new printed leaf (h33-g5: ZInQ.H33G5.TYZThm33AdelicSome; G5 proved in Lean: strong approximation GL2(A_f) = GL2(Q)+ U0(N) (AdelicX0.strong_approx), Gamma0(N)\H = GL2(Q)+\(H x GL2(A_f)/U0(N)) (gamma0OrbitsEquiv), fixed point of TYZ's matrices = tau_n and f0(P_n) = [tau_n, 1] (f0_tyzP5, f0_tyzP7), IsPointAt Gamma0(N)-invariant; equivalent in Lean to h33-d1's TYZThm33CurveSome (tyzThm33AdelicSome_iff); G7 points-level model change proved (tyzEquiv, commutes with [i]); G2 analytic level proved (shFunEquiv, x0Field_eq_adjoin_ratFnSh: X0Field N = field generated by the q-expansions of rational functions on GL2(Q)+\(H x GL2(A_f)/U0(N))); readings left: G2 scheme level (TYZ's X_U0(32) = Shimura's canonical model is the model (X, iota): definition of the canonical model, no Lean definition exists), sign of [i] and f_n = f0 - f0.[i] read on A (G6, h33-sign); journal version not checked
